name: Window
description: Represents a window. Many document characteristics, such as scroll bars and rulers, are actually properties of the window.
remarks: The Window object is a member of the Windows collection. The Windows collection for the Application object contains all the windows in the application, whereas the Windows collection for the Document object contains only the windows that display the specified document. Use Windows (Index), where Index is the window name or the index number, to return a single Window object. The following example maximizes the Document1 window. The index number is the number to the left of the window name on the Window menu. The following example displays the caption of the first window in the Windows collection. Use the Add method or the NewWindow method to add a new window to the Windows collection. Each of the following statements creates a new window for the document in the active window. A colon (:) and a number appear in the window caption when more than one window is open for a document. When you switch the view to print preview, a new window is created. This window is removed from the Windows collection when you close print preview.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft OfficeWord application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Window object.

properties.name: ActivePane
properties.description: Returns a Pane object that represents the active pane for the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: Document
properties.description: Returns a Document object associated with the specified pane, window, or selection. Read-only.

properties.name: Panes
properties.description: Returns a Panes collection that represents all the window panes for the specified window.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns the Selection object that represents a selected range or the insertion point. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the horizontal position of the specified window, measured in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical position of the specified document window, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the specified document window, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the window (in points). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Split
properties.description: True if the window is split into multiple panes. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SplitVertical
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical split percentage for the specified window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets the caption text for the window that is displayed in the title bar of the document or application window. Read/write String.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the specified document window or task window. Read/write WdWindowState.

properties.name: DisplayRulers
properties.description: True if rulers are displayed for the specified window or pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayVerticalRuler
properties.description: True if a vertical ruler is displayed for the specified window or pane. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: View
properties.description: Returns a View object that represents the view for the specified window or pane.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the window type. Read-only WdWindowType.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns the next document window in the collection of open document windows. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns the previous document window in the collection open document windows. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayVerticalScrollBar
properties.description: True if a vertical scroll bar is displayed for the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayHorizontalScrollBar
properties.description: True if a horizontal scroll bar is displayed for the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: StyleAreaWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the style area in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DisplayScreenTips
properties.description: True if comments, footnotes, endnotes, and hyperlinks are displayed as tips. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HorizontalPercentScrolled
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal scroll position as a percentage of the document width. Read/write Long.

properties.name: VerticalPercentScrolled
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical scroll position as a percentage of the document length. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DocumentMap
properties.description: True if the document map is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: True if the specified window is active. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of an item in a collection. Read-only.

properties.name: IMEMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the default start-up mode for the Japanese Input Method Editor (IME). Read/write WdIMEMode.

properties.name: UsableWidth
properties.description: Returns the width (in points) of the active working area in the specified document window. Read-only Long.

properties.name: UsableHeight
properties.description: Returns the height (in points) of the active working area in the specified document window. Read-only Long. .

properties.name: EnvelopeVisible
properties.description: True if the email message header is visible in the document window. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayRightRuler
properties.description: True if the vertical ruler appears on the right side of the document window in print layout view. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayLeftScrollBar
properties.description: True if the vertical scroll bar appears on the left side of the document window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Thumbnails
properties.description: Sets or returns a Boolean that represents whether thumbnail images of the pages in a document are displayed along the left side of the Microsoft Word document window.

properties.name: ShowSourceDocuments
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdShowSourceDocuments constant that represents how Microsoft Word displays source documents after a compare and merge process. Read/write.

properties.name: Hwnd
properties.description: Returns a Long that indicates the window handle of the specified window. Read-only.

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: Specifies the save action for the document. Can be one of the following WdSaveOptions constants: wdDoNotSaveChanges, wdPromptToSaveChanges, or wdSaveChanges.

parameters.name: RouteDocument
parameters.description: True to route the document to the next recipient. If the document doesn't have a routing slip attached, this argument is ignored.

methods.name: LargeScroll
methods.signature: LargeScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant])
methods.description: Scrolls a window or pane by the specified number of screens.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of screens to scroll the window down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of screens to scroll the window up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of screens to scroll the window to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of screens to scroll the window to the left.

methods.name: SmallScroll
methods.signature: SmallScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant])
methods.description: Scrolls a window or pane by the specified number of lines.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of lines to scroll the window down. A "line" corresponds to the distance scrolled by clicking the down scroll arrow on the vertical scroll bar once.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of lines to scroll the window up. A "line" corresponds to the distance scrolled by clicking the up scroll arrow on the vertical scroll bar once.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of lines to scroll the window to the right. A "line" corresponds to the distance scrolled by clicking the right scroll arrow on the horizontal scroll bar once.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of lines to scroll the window to the left. A "line" corresponds to the distance scrolled by clicking the left scroll arrow on the horizontal scroll bar once.

methods.name: NewWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window with the same document as the specified window. Returns a Window object.

methods.name: PageScroll
methods.description: Scrolls through the specified pane or window page by page.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of pages to be scrolled down. If this argument is omitted, this value is assumed to be 1.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of pages to be scrolled up.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets the focus of the specified document window to the body of an email message.

methods.name: RangeFromPoint
methods.signature: RangeFromPoint(x As Long, y As Long) As Object
methods.description: Returns the Range or Shape object that is located at the point specified by the screen position coordinate pair.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The horizontal distance (in pixels) from the left edge of the screen to the point.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The vertical distance (in pixels) from the top of the screen to the point.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls through the document window so the specified range or shape is displayed in the document window.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A Range or Shape object.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: True if the upper-left corner of the range or shape appears at the upper-left corner of the document window. False if the lower-right corner of the range or shape appears at the lower-right corner of the document window. The default value is True.

methods.name: GetPoint
methods.signature: GetPoint(ScreenPixelsLeft As Long, ScreenPixelsTop As Long, ScreenPixelsWidth As Long, ScreenPixelsHeight As Long, obj As Object)
methods.description: Returns the screen coordinates of the specified range or shape.

parameters.name: ScreenPixelsLeft
parameters.description: The variable name to which you want Microsoft Word to return the value for the left edge of the object.

parameters.name: ScreenPixelsTop
parameters.description: The variable name to which you want Word to return the value for the top edge of the object.

parameters.name: ScreenPixelsWidth
parameters.description: The variable name to which you want Word to return the value for the width of the object.

parameters.name: ScreenPixelsHeight
parameters.description: The variable name to which you want Word to return the value for the height of the object.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A Range or Shape object.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([Background As Variant], [Append As Variant], [Range As Variant], [OutputFileName As Variant], [From As Variant], [To As Variant], [Item As Variant], [Copies As Variant], [Pages As Variant], [PageType As Variant], [PrintToFile As Variant], [Collate As Variant], [ActivePrinterMacGX As Variant], [ManualDuplexPrint As Variant], [PrintZoomColumn As Variant], [PrintZoomRow As Variant], [PrintZoomPaperWidth As Variant], [PrintZoomPaperHeight As Variant])
methods.description: Prints all or part of the document displayed in the specified window.

parameters.name: Background
parameters.description: Set to True to have the macro continue while Microsoft Word prints the document.

parameters.name: Append
parameters.description: Set to True to append the specified document to the file name specified by the OutputFileName argument. False to overwrite the contents of OutputFileName.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The page range. Can be any WdPrintOutRange constant.

parameters.name: OutputFileName
parameters.description: If PrintToFile is True, this argument specifies the path and file name of the output file.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The starting page number when Range is set to wdPrintFromTo.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The ending page number when Range is set to wdPrintFromTo.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: The item to be printed. Can be any WdPrintOutItem constant.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to be printed.

parameters.name: Pages
parameters.description: The page numbers and page ranges to be printed, separated by commas. For example, "2, 6-10" prints page 2 and pages 6 through 10.

parameters.name: PageType
parameters.description: The type of pages to be printed. Can be any WdPrintOutPages constant.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: True to send printer instructions to a file. Make sure to specify a file name with OutputFileName.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: When printing multiple copies of a document, True to print all pages of the document before printing the next copy.

parameters.name: ActivePrinterMacGX
parameters.description: This argument is available only in Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition. For additional information about this argument, consult the language reference Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: ManualDuplexPrint
parameters.description: True to print a two-sided document on a printer without a duplex printing kit. If this argument is True, the PrintBackground and PrintReverse properties are ignored. Use the PrintOddPagesInAscendingOrder and PrintEvenPagesInAscendingOrder properties to control the output during manual duplex printing. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: PrintZoomColumn
parameters.description: The number of pages you want Word to fit horizontally on one page. Can be 1, 2, 3, or 4. Use with the PrintZoomRow argument to print multiple pages on a single sheet.

parameters.name: PrintZoomRow
parameters.description: The number of pages you want Word to fit vertically on one page. Can be 1, 2, or 4. Use with the PrintZoomColumn argument to print multiple pages on a single sheet.

parameters.name: PrintZoomPaperWidth
parameters.description: The width to which you want Word to scale printed pages, in twips (20 twips = 1 point; 72 points = 1 inch).

parameters.name: PrintZoomPaperHeight
parameters.description: The height to which you want Word to scale printed pages, in twips (20 twips = 1 point; 72 points = 1 inch).
